violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed PIC scratch his nose with gloved hands. PIC proceeded to move a container of frozen chicken with the gloved hand without washing or changing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TAKE GLOVES OFF AND WASH HANDS. WASH HANDS FREQUENTLY, ESPECIALLY BEFORE PUTTING ON NEW GLOVES, RETURNING TO THE KITCHEN, TOUCHING BODY PARTS, ETC. PIC WASH HIS HANDS

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) In the 3DR salad prep top cooler: observed Raw salmon over cooked black beans and cooked chopped chicken 2) In the 3DR prep top cooler across from the fryer: observed frozen Raw chicken being stored in the top of the prep top cooler over ready-to-eat sauces and ready-to-eat empanadas
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW FROZEN CHICKEN INTO THE FREEZER. KEEP RAW FROZEN CHICKEN IN THE FREEZER TO AVOID CROSS CONTAMINATION. PIC MOVE THE RAW SALMON TO THE BOTTOM SHELF NEXT TO THE BEANS AND CHICKEN.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR expo, right side cooler: salsa (50f), crema (52f) 2) on ice: salsa (52f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE SALSA AND CREMA. LOOK CINEMAS (Inspection Date: 09/01/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: A dead mouse was observed stuck to a sticky trap in the back corner, under a prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. REMOVE ALL DEAD PESTS FROM PREMISES.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed CLEAR FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS, MIXING BOWLS, AND POPCORN BOWLS that have been cleaned not stored covered or inverted.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. PIC FLIPPED THE FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS OVER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 2DR expo, right side cooler was observed at 64f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. DISCONTINUE USING THIS COOLER TO STORE TCS FOODS (IE: CREMA AND SALSA). REPAIR OR REPLACE COOLER TO ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE MAINTAINED AT 41f OR COLDER.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.observation: Observed spray bottles of cleaning products being stored on the same cart that is stored food and single service items.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC MOVED THE CLEANING PRODUCTS TO THE STORAGE CLOSET.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) high temperature dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no Certified Food Manager present during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD PREPARATION. IT IS RECOMMENDED TO HAVE MULTIPLE STAFF MEMBERS CERTIFIED. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: The hand sink across from the high temperature dish machine was observed without paper towels.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REFILLED THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: The hot water for the high temperature dish machine was observed at 127f utilizing the high temperature dish plate.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE THE SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE. DISCONTINUE THE USE OF THE DISH MACHINE FOR SANITIZATION. WASHING MAY OCCUR IN THE DISH MACHINE, BUT SANITIZATION MUST OCCUR IN THE THREE COMPARTMENT SINK. SERVICE TECHNICIAN ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION IS MAKING REPAIRS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: seasoned flour, regular flour, and coconut breadcrumbs.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC RELABELED THE BULK BINS OF SEASONED FLOUR, REGULAR FLOUR, AND COCONUT BREADCRUMBS

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed a box of ground beef being stored directly on the floor of the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC MOVED THE FOOD ONTO A NEARBY SHELF.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed ice cream scoops being stored in a ConserveWell. Hot water in the ConserveWell was observed at 105f-107f.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WASH, RINSE, AND SANITIZED THE ICE CREAM SCOOPS. STORE SCOOPS IN A DRY CONTAINER.
